verdict.rationale: Asking whether customer data is used to train AI models is a fair privacy question for a SaaS video API that processes customer media and offers AI features such as noise cancellation and transcription. The pack, however, contains no AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or no-training commitment. Encrypted recordings and HIPAA support are adjacent privacy features, not training controls, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
